findings.message: 11 reviewed connector pins match: single HOT bus, no midpoint; bias, relay and permit returns are PFC_BUS_MINUS, distinct from PE

The reviewed setpoint is 389.615 V nominal, not a guaranteed maximum. Ripple, overshoot and faults require a source-bound bus envelope before rating downstream consumers. Legacy split-bus consumers are not accepted.

External regulated 15 V bias must return to HOT PFC_BUS_MINUS. The auxiliary unit, load/startup budget, source architecture and isolation evidence are absent; CTRL_GND or PE cannot substitute for this return.

HOT permit and relay-bypass inputs need isolated external producers and verified startup, precharge, loss-of-bias, reset and fault sequencing. Default-off static topology is not a shutdown timing or stored-energy guarantee.
15 A RMS and PF 0.99 bound nominal 120 V input to 1782 W before losses. Low-line foldback and fault/inrush currents remain unmodeled; a nominal 1800 W target cannot waive the input-current limit.
executed source-bound UVLO cases: 9.0 V guarantees off while 12.0 V remains in the startup uncertainty band
executed independent datasheet-bound scenario: VSENSE standby threshold
executed independent datasheet-bound scenario: high OVP shutdown
executed independent datasheet-bound scenario: ISENSE open-pin shutdown
executed datasheet case remains indeterminate: ICOMP unit ambiguity
executed independent datasheet-bound scenario: SOC average-current limit
executed independent datasheet-bound scenario: PCL immediate gate shutdown
UVLO inhibits PWM at the tested 9 V point; the inhibit-clamp release versus UVLO sequence during bias decay is not time-modeled
controller PWM disable is not galvanic mains isolation; external disconnect and discharge behavior are unmodeled
datasheet provides no guaranteed propagation delay for UVLO, OLP, OVP, ISOP, ICOMP, SOC, or PCL shutdown
HCSM2818FT10L0 is 10 mΩ ±1%, 5 W nominal with 500 mm² PCB copper and surface below 100 °C; thermal qualification remains separate

coverage_gaps: The reviewed setpoint is 389.615 V nominal, not a guaranteed maximum. Ripple, overshoot and faults require a source-bound bus envelope before rating downstream consumers. Legacy split-bus consumers are not accepted.

External regulated 15 V bias must return to HOT PFC_BUS_MINUS. The auxiliary unit, load/startup budget, source architecture and isolation evidence are absent; CTRL_GND or PE cannot substitute for this return.

HOT permit and relay-bypass inputs need isolated external producers and verified startup, precharge, loss-of-bias, reset and fault sequencing. Default-off static topology is not a shutdown timing or stored-energy guarantee.
15 A RMS and PF 0.99 bound nominal 120 V input to 1782 W before losses. Low-line foldback and fault/inrush currents remain unmodeled; a nominal 1800 W target cannot waive the input-current limit.
UCC28180 datasheet does not provide a guaranteed propagation delay for these shutdown paths
PWM inhibition does not provide mains isolation or disconnect the rectifier/boost bus; an external mains disconnect and stored-energy discharge contract is missing

0.2 mm local / 2 mm between elevated-voltage domains / 6 mm to PE are retained construction floors. Surface creepage, package-internal insulation, pollution degree, material group and surge qualification are not established by this copper-clearance check.
External isolated bias supply, HOT permit, precharge and bypass sequencing are required; this harness does not implement them.
15 A RMS foldback/PF behavior is a declared input constraint, not a measured result.
Bus bleeder decay, relay timing, semiconductor/capacitor thermal limits, EMC, insulation and mains qualification are NOT RUN.
